item.title: Garamond
item.description: Garamond is a group of many serif typefaces, named for sixteenth-century Parisian engraver Claude Garamond, generally spelled as Garamont in his lifetime. Garamond-style typefaces are popular and particularly often used for book printing and body text.

item.title: Univers
item.description: The OG Helvetica. Univers was one of the first typeface families to fulfil the idea that a typeface should form a family of consistent, related designs.
